ns2:course.label: Analog Signal Processing
ns2:course.description: (ECE 210) Introduction to analog signal processing, with an emphasis on underlying concepts from circuit and system analysis: linear systems, review of elementary circuit analysis, differential equation models of linear circuits and systems, Laplace transform, convolution, stability, phasors, frequency response, Fourier series, Fourier transform, active filters and AM radio. Prerequisite: ECE 110 and PHYS 212; credit or concurrent registration in MATH 385, MATH 386, or MATH 441.
